description: Use this when the user asks what they make per unit after VAT, marketplace commission (noon, Amazon), fulfilment, ads and costs, or their break-even price or margin. Unit economics for a UAE seller in AED: what is left of a selling price after 5% VAT, coupons, marketplace commission, fulfilment, storage, ads, returns, purchase cost, shipping, customs and packaging, with margin, markup, break-even price, monthly profit and break-even units. VAT is handled both ways: output VAT is taken out of the price when the seller is VAT registered, and VAT charged on purchases and fees is a cost only when it cannot be reclaimed. Costs are excluding VAT. Anything not given counts as 0; use only figures the user gave, as fees differ by marketplace and category. Do not use it for a connected business's actual profit and loss (get_profit_and_loss).

ad_cost_per_unit.description: Ad spend per unit sold, AED.

ad_percent_of_sales.description: Ad spend as % of net sales. Or use ad_cost_per_unit.

business_type.description: noon, amazon, own_store, trading or services. Decides which costs apply.

commission_on_vat_inclusive_price.description: Commission is charged on the VAT-inclusive price.

commission_percent.description: Marketplace commission, or payment and platform fees, in %.

customs_cost.description: Customs duty and clearance per unit, AED.

fees_vat_charged.description: The platform adds 5% VAT on its commission, fulfilment and storage fees.

fixed_monthly_costs.description: Licence, rent, staff, software… per month, AED.

fulfilment_fee.description: Fulfilment or delivery per unit, AED excluding VAT.

price_includes_vat.description: true when the price already includes 5% VAT. Default false.

purchase_cost.description: Purchase cost per unit excluding VAT (services: direct cost per job), AED.

purchase_vat_charged.description: The supplier adds 5% VAT on the purchase cost.

storage_fee.description: Storage per unit sold, AED excluding VAT.

vat_registered.description: Whether the seller is VAT registered.

name: calculate_profit
title: Calculate profit per unit
